last_result.headline: Q18's conclusion SURVIVES the Q39 correction but its reasoning did not. Under the measured and evidence-supported cell (retrieval -0.031, GR-sigma edge NOT transferring per Q36) the price of our-account-first is +0.0005 worst / +0.0402 mean -- essentially Q18's +0.000/+0.040, reached by a different mechanism. Two wrong inputs were cancelling: the old model overstated retrieval AND let the sigma edge survive under H-hidden; fixing only one would have flipped the answer to +0.080. Pair recommendation unchanged (score-first's nominal shift is 0.0045, half the replicate spread); ties remain 6-11 vs Q18's 9. THE SLOT-1 QUESTION REDUCES TO: does GR-sigma help on NOVEL wells? Gap is 0.0005 if not, 0.1110 if yes. Decision unchanged: ownership judgement, and no submission can settle it.
